meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装上后,当你提到 PR 或 Qodo 时,Claude 会抓取当前分支的合并请求(PR/MR)上 Qodo 的审查意见,列出问题表格,再按你的选择逐条批准修改或自动批量修复,回复每条内联评论,并提交推送。
howto.when: 当你说出“qodo”“PR”“review”等关键词,或要求查看、修复 Qodo 审查意见时触发。

say.text: 看看这个分支的 PR 上 Qodo 发现了什么问题
say.note: 它会抓取审查意见并列出问题表格。

say.text: 把 Qodo 指出的严重问题都自动修掉
say.note: 会进入自动修复模式,逐项提交修复。

say.text: 逐条带我过一遍 Qodo 的审查意见
say.note: 会逐条展示修复方案并等你确认。

howto.what_en: After install, when you mention a PR or Qodo, Claude fetches Qodo's review issues for the current branch's PR/MR, shows them, then fixes them one-by-one or in batch, replies to each inline comment, and commits and pushes changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "qodo", "PR", or "review", or ask to view/fix Qodo review issues.

say_en.text: Check what Qodo found on this branch's PR.
say_en.note: Fetches review issues and shows them.

say_en.text: Auto-fix all critical issues Qodo flagged.
say_en.note: Enters auto-fix mode and commits each fix.

say_en.text: Walk me through Qodo's review comments one by one.
say_en.note: Shows each suggested fix and waits for approval.
